Original User Story: As a moderator, I want to create a new game by entering a name and an optional description, so that I can start inviting estimators.
Rewritten User Story:
User Story:
As a moderator, I want to initiate the creation of a new game by providing a name and an optional description, so that I can efficiently begin the process of inviting estimators to participate.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Successfully enter a game name that meets the character limit of 50 characters or fewer.
- Optionally include a description of up to 200 characters to provide context for the game.
- Confirm that the game is created and visible in the game list, allowing for immediate invitations to be sent to estimators.

Test Outline:
- Validate that the game name input field accepts valid entries and rejects those exceeding the character limit.
- Check that the optional description field allows for input and adheres to the specified character limit.
- Ensure that the newly created game appears in the game list and that invitations can be sent to estimators without errors.

Original User Story: As a moderator, I want to invite estimators by giving them a URL where they can access the game, so that we can start the game.
Rewritten User Story:
User Story:
As a moderator, I want to send a unique URL to estimators for accessing the game, so that we can efficiently initiate the game session and ensure all participants are ready to contribute.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Generate a unique, secure URL for each estimator that allows access to the game.
- Ensure that the URL is sent to all invited estimators within 2 minutes of the invitation being issued.
- Confirm that at least 90% of invited estimators can successfully access the game using the provided URL.

Test Outline:
- Verify that a unique URL is created for each estimator upon invitation.
- Track the time taken to send the URL to ensure it meets the 2-minute requirement.
- Test the access of the URL by a sample of estimators to confirm that at least 90% can join the game without issues.

Original User Story: As a moderator, I want to start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field, so that we can estimate it.
Rewritten User Story:
User Story:
As a moderator, I want to initiate a round by inputting an item into a single multi-line text field, so that we can efficiently estimate its value and facilitate a smooth discussion.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The multi-line text field must accept input of at least 500 characters to accommodate detailed item descriptions.
- The system should allow the moderator to submit the item with a single action, ensuring a seamless transition to the estimation phase.
- Confirmation of the item submission should be displayed within 2 seconds to ensure the moderator is aware that the item is ready for estimation.

Test Outline:
- Test the multi-line text field to confirm it accepts the maximum character limit without errors.
- Verify that the item submission process can be completed with one click and transitions to the estimation phase.
- Measure the time taken to display the confirmation message after submission to ensure it meets the 2-second requirement.

Original User Story: As a moderator, I want to see all items we try to estimate this session, so that I can answer questions about the current story such as does this include ___
Rewritten User Story:
User Story:
As a moderator, I want to have visibility of all items we plan to estimate during this session so that I can effectively address any questions regarding the current story, such as whether it encompasses specific features or requirements.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Display a comprehensive list of all items scheduled for estimation in the current session.
- Ensure that each item includes a brief description to clarify its scope and context.
- Provide a mechanism for moderators to quickly reference and respond to questions about the inclusion of specific elements within the current story.

Test Outline:
- Verify that the list of items is accurately populated and visible to the moderator at the start of the session.
- Check that each item has a clear description that can be accessed easily.
- Test the responsiveness of the moderator in addressing questions related to the items listed during the session.

Original User Story: As a moderator, I want to select an item to be estimated or re-estimated, so that the team sees that item and can estimate it.
Rewritten User Story:
User Story:
As a moderator, I want to choose an item for estimation or re-estimation so that the team can review and provide their estimates, ensuring that all items are accurately assessed for project planning.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The moderator can successfully select an item from the list for estimation or re-estimation.
- The selected item must be visible to all team members within 2 minutes of selection.
- The team should be able to submit their estimates for the selected item within a defined timeframe of 10 minutes.

Test Outline:
- Verify that the moderator can select an item and that the selection process is intuitive and efficient.
- Check that the selected item appears on the team’s dashboard within the specified time limit.
- Confirm that team members can submit their estimates for the item and that the submission process is completed within the allotted timeframe.
